X_Table_Text_SystemHelp_000021	Bazaar and Auction House
X_Table_Text_SystemHelp_000022	1. Functions of the Bazaar {n}{n}The Bazaar is where players can buy or sell Items, such as Gear, Crafting Materials, and other Items they need. It can also be used to sell Items to earn Dragon Coins. Players can also use the Auction House to bid for Rare Items or buy them at Buyout Prices. {n}{n}2. How to buy and sell? {n}{n}Buy: Click on the option [I am a buyer] and select the category of Items you need to buy the Items you need at the quantity you desire. {n}{n}Sell: Click on the option [I am a seller] and select the Items to sell. Click to put the Item on the shelf. Be patient, though. Shelving is not instantaneous and it will take several minutes before it appears in the Bazaar. {n}{n}Bound after Purchase: Item will be bound after the purchase. Cannot be listed. {n}{n}3. Auction House {n}{n}Guild Auction House: [a431e2]When the events Guild Boss, Guild Arena, Clash of Mines, World Boss, and Guild Territory Fight[-]end, Guild Ranking will be used as a reference to release Rare Items that Guild Members can then bid for. Different Guilds will get different Items. After the Auction ends, the total sum from the Auction will be distributed to all Guild Members who participated in the Event. {n}{n}For the last 30 seconds of the Auction, any player who successfully bids for a product will extend the remaining time by another 30 seconds until the Bidding Price is the same as the Buyout Price. {n}{n}World Auction House: Items that no one bid for at the Guild Auction House will be gathered at the World Auction House to allow bidding by every player in the entire Server. Items that no one bid for at the World Auction will be recalled by the system.

Album Combinations can also improve BP. {n}{n}2. There is a chance to receive a Bonus Dice that can be used immediately as a Normal Dice. {n}{n}3. The Adventure Feature provides a random Album that can be used to form Album Combinations to boost Character Attribute. {n}{n}4. A random Album of different quality will be generated according to the Treasure Chest Slot quality. {n}{n}5. The Finishing Line Treasure Chest will produce a high quality Rare Album.

X_Table_Text_SystemHelp_000062	Feature Instructions {n}{n}1. Players can engage in the Matching System to engage in a 1v1 fight with other players. {n}{n}2. Players that kill the opponent within the specified time win. A draw occurs when both players are still standing after the count down ends. {n}{n}Ladder Rating {n}{n}1. Initial Rating starts at 1,500 Points. Victories provide additional Points, while defeats result in a deduction. No more deductions will be made if the rating is less than 1,500 Points. {n}{n}2. Rating Rewards are finalized every 3 weeks. The day of finalization is the 3rd Sun. evening at 20:00. The system will refer to Rating Ranks to issue Ranking Rewards to the players. {n}{n}3. Rating Rewards can be acquired every week by improving Rating Score. {n}{n}Matching System {n}{n}1. During Matching, the player will be Matched against another player with a similar Rating Score. Combat will not take place between players with large Rating differences. {n}{n}Players with higher Victory Ratings will acquire higher Ladder Ratings, and vice versa. {n}{n}Fair Mode Details {n}{n}1. To ensure fairness, the Ladder Competition adopts the Fair Mode. {n}{n}2. Under Fair Mode, player HP, ATK, DEF, and other Attribute are transformed to preset stats of the system. {n}{n}3. Under Fair Mode, Skill Level will not affect Skill Power. {n}{n}Reward {n}{n}1. Participate in the Ladder every day to earn bonus Glory Point Rewards. {n}{n}2. Players can pick up 1 Rating Reward every week according to their Rating Score. {n}{n}3. Rank Rewards are issued every week by mail according to the player’s Ranking. {n}{n}4. Glory Points can be used to purchase Items you desire from the Glory Shop.{n}{n}

X_Table_Text_SystemHelp_000086	Guild Arena
X_Table_Text_SystemHelp_000087	1. Event Rewards \n\nEvery member of participating Guilds can acquire vast amounts of Guild Contribution. \n\nThe Champion and First Runner-up of the Clash of Aces can obtain a Bonus Reward of Dragon Coins. \n\n2. Event Time \n\nUnlocked 2 weeks after Server launch. Each season last 2 weeks. \n\nThe Guild Leader or Deputy Leader shall register for the event on the first Mon. to Tue. 19:00 of the season. \n\nRegistered Guilds will engage in a Point Match every Tue. and Thur. evening at 20:00 during the season. \n\nThe Clash of Aces shall take place on the same Sat. at 20:00 when the 2nd Week Point Match of the season ends. \n\n3. Participation Conditions \n\nGuilds that have reached Level 2 may register and participate in the Event. \n\n4. Event Rules \n\nThere are 4 Point Match sessions. Registered Guilds shall be randomly matched to another Guild for 3 rounds of 6v6 Combat. \n\nThe Guild that earns more victories in each round will be victorious. When the number of victories are the same, then the Guild dealing more DMG wins. \n\nParticipating Guild Members must fight in the Arena. Each victory provides the Guild with 10 Points. \n\nDefeats do not provide any Points. Players can only participate in 1 round of each Point Match. \n\nThe Top 8 Guilds of the Point Match will enter the Clash of Aces which takes place on the evening of the same Sat.. \n\nThe following is the schedule for the Clash of Aces: Quarterfinals start at 20:00; Semifinals start at 20:20; and Finals start at 20:40. \n\nFor each Competition, players of participating Guilds have 2 minutes to prepare themselves for the Arena. \n\nEach Guild can deploy 5 of its Members to engage in a 1v1 Rotation Battle. \n\nThe Guild Leader and Deputy Leader can remove Members who have yet to engage in battle from the list of deployed players. \n\nEvery Member of participating Guilds will receive a generous Reward. \n\nWhen the Event ends, the system will refer to the Guild Arena Ranking to release special, Rare Items to the Guild Auction House. \n\nAll Guild Members may bid for these Items. All Guild Members will receive a share of the Bonus Profit obtained through the sales of the Items.

Town Territory and the Capital of Divine Paradise will be unlocked with every success. {n}{n}After the Guild occupies a Territory, a large number of Moniker Rewards will be released to the Guild Auction House. Event Time {n}{n}Territory Fight starts every Sun. from 20:00 to 20:30. {n}{n}The target of declaration can be replaced any time from 0500 of the day to 5 minutes before the start of the Fight. {n}{n}Once the Event starts, the Guild can only attack the Territory that they’ve successfully declared war against and earned Fighting Rights for, or defend a Territory that they have already occupied. {n}{n}4. X_Table_Text_SystemHelp_000271	Mentorship System
X_Table_Text_SystemHelp_000272	Mentorship
X_Table_Text_SystemHelp_000273	1. Conditions for Getting a Mentor {n}{n}Reach Level 20 {n}{n}Have less than 2 Mentors currently. {n}{n}Not subject to the Mentorship Termination Punishment Period. {n}{n}No previous Graduation. {n}{n}2. Conditions for Getting an Apprentice {n}{n}Apprentice Level Requirement is different for different Seals {n}{n}Have less than 2 Apprentices currently. {n}{n}Not an Apprentice to another Mentor. {n}{n}Not subject to the Mentorship Termination Punishment Period. {n}{n}3. Time Gap Between Accepting Apprentices {n}{n}Another Mentorship can only be initiated 7 days after successful Mentorship. The first 2 Apprentices are not subject to this time limitation. {n}{n}4. Mentorship Grant {n}{n}Once per day, the Mentor can Grant Power to an Apprentice who has yet to Graduate. The Level of the Mentor must be higher than that of the Apprentice. {n}{n}5. Apprentice Quest {n}{n}After forming a Mentorship, the Apprentice will obtain a number of Mentorship Quests. The Apprentice can report to the Mentor after completing these Mentorship Quests, and both the Mentor and Apprentice will receive Rewards once the report has been received. If the Mentorship Quests have been completed before forming the Mentorship, a report will not be required and the Quest will be tagged as having been completed. {n}{n}6. Mentorship Graduation {n}{n}Find the Magician NPC in Town to perform the Graduation Ceremony. Graduation can be divided into Normal and Perfect Graduations, and only 1 type can be selected. After Graduation, the Mentor/Apprentice Slot will no longer be occupied and Mentorship Quests will no longer be available. {n}{n}Normal Graduation: Mentorship for at least 14 days and completing 30 or more Mentorship Quests. {n}{n}Perfect Graduation: Mentorship for at least 14 days and completing 40 or more Mentorship Quests. {n}{n}7. Force Graduation: When the player satisfies the Normal/Perfect Graduation Conditions but the Mentor/Apprentice has not been online for more than 3 days, the Mentor/Apprentice may head to the Magician NPC in Town to apply for Force Graduation. After Graduation, the un-reported Mentor Quests will be directly reported to the system to provide corresponding Mentorship Rewards. {n}{n}8. Terminate Mentorship {n}{n}Both the Mentor/Apprentice may choose to independently head to the Magician NPC in Town to Terminate the Mentorship. The request may be rescinded within a period of 24 hours after submission. The Mentorship is officially Terminated after 24 hours after submission. {n}{n}9. Mentorship Termination Punishment {n}{n}Players cannot initiate any Mentorship activities for a period of 7 days after officially Terminating a Mentorship. However, the Punishment Period will not be enforced if the other party of the Mentorship has not been online for more than 3 days when the Termination Request has been submitted.

X_Table_SystemHelp_OB6_00001	Cross-server Guild War
X_Table_SystemHelp_OB6_00002	1. Participating in Guild Selection {n}{n}The first week of every calendar month is the Guild Selection Week of the Cross-server Guild Battle. The top 5 Guilds in the Territory Fight of this week will automatically enter the Points Match of the Cross-server Guild Battle on behalf of their own server {n}{n}2. Points Match of the Cross-server Guild War {n}{n}By default, the selected Guilds will compete with 20 Guilds from 4 adjacent servers in the form of the Points Match. In the end, 8 Guilds will be selected on the basis of their score and the total Kills and enter the Cross-server Playoffs {n}{n}3. Cross-server Guild War Playoffs {n}{n}The Guilds who enter the quarterfinals will fight each other to win the championship of the Cross-server Guild Battle and the Guilds that lose in the battle will be eliminated {n}{n}4. Server-wide World Auction Bonus {n}{n}During the conclusion to determine the champion of the Cross-server Guild Battle, according to the ranking of the Guild ranked highest in the Cross-server Guild Battle made by the server, the system will issue rewards of the Server-wide World Auction for players from all servers to auction, and the bonuses they auction will be distributed to active players of all servers {n}{n}5. Championship Guessing Support {n}{n}When the quarterfinal Guilds are selected at the end of the Points Match, all players from the involved servers can select two Guilds that they support from the eight Guilds. If the Guild they support wins the championship in the end, they will receive Guessing Rewards.

A large number of Individual Rewards and Guild Rewards can be obtained each week via participating in Guild Hunting independently or together with other members of the Guild. Guild Hunting is reset every Monday at 5am. {n}2. Resource Points and Tech Points obtained through Guild Hunting will be directly delivered to the Guild where the mission was completed. The Guild Leader can use the Resource Points and Tech Points to study the Guild Asylum and Guild Skills to enhance the overall strength of the Guild. {n}There is a limit to the number of Resource Points and Tech Points that can be provided by Guild Members within a week. There is no upper limit for Individual Rewards.

X_Table_SystemHelp_OB6_00011	Infinite Dreamland
X_Table_SystemHelp_OB6_00012	1. How to Play {n}{n}Infinite Dreamland is a 4-player tower challenge game, and the Dreamland will level up with the increase of the World Level. {n}Monsters in the Dreamland can obtain affix bonuses. The higher the layer is, the more affix bonuses the monsters can get. {n}Kill all monsters within a set time to complete the stage and continue to challenge a higher level. {n}The completion score in stars allows you to skip the same amount of levels. For example, if 3 Stars were obtained when completing Layer 1, the next challenge will be Layer 4. {n}The faster the stage is completed, the more Stars you receive. 3 Stars is the highest, and you can skip up to Level 10. {n}[FFFF00]The countdown will be deducted by 30 seconds upon death. [-]Respawning is allowed after death. {n}The Infinite Dreamland will be reset every Monday at 5am. Stages and stage affixes will be randomized {n}When reset, the challenge stage will all be reset to Level 1. When the Infinite Dreamland levels up, all stages of this server will be reset to Level 1. {n}{n}2. Reward Mechanism {n}{n}First Clear Reward: Directly claim the rewards from "Reward - First Clear Reward" on the main screen after passing the current level and a higher level for the first time at each week. {n}Guaranteed Reward: For completing level 3, level 6, and level 9 in the previous week, corresponding Guaranteed Rewards will be issued when resetting the next week. {n}Ranking Reward: Rewards are issued to members according to the ranking of the Team. Cross-server achievement will not be included in the ranking.

Inscription{n}{n}Dragon-Ware Inscription is unlocked at Lv.55. Inscriptions can be used to replace skills of the Dragon-Ware{n}1 original skill of the Dragon-Ware will be replaced or 1 new skill will be added with probabilities after embedding an Inscription{n}[a431e2]Only “Directly Increase Skill Damage” and “Directly Decrease Skill CD” on different parts of Dragon-Ware can stack{n}Other buffs cannot stack!![-]{n} Only 1 skill at most can be added on Dragon-Ware{n}{n}3. Dragon-Ware Reforge{n}{n}S-grade Dragon-Ware above Lv.55 can be reforged with [a431e2]Reforge Stone[-]. The set and parts of the Dragon-Ware will not be random after being reforged{n}[a431e2]. Attributes and skills will be randomly replaced[-]{n}{n}4. Dragon-Ware Melding{n}{n}S-grade Dragon-Wares above Lv.55 of the same level and part can be melded. You can choose the main Ware and the part to be melded{n}Need an auxiliary Ware to meld and the skills on it will be transferred to the main Ware after a successful melding. Whether success or failure, {n}the Dragon-Ware melded will disappear. Melding Stone can improve the success probability of melding{n}(2 Skills melding with 2 Skills, 3 Skills melding with 3 Skills: all skills will be replaced if success){n}(2 Skill melding with 3 Skill: 2 Skills will be randomly replaced; 3 Skills melding with 2 Skills: 2 Skills will be randomly replaced){n}{n}5. Dragon-Ware Polish{n}{n}Polish Stone will be gained after completing Infinite Dreamland. Polish Stone can be used to randomly change the Dragon Ware Attributes.
